decisions.headline: 科乐美公布新作《Rhapsody in Scarlet》，以魔法与召唤兽组合连段
decisions.reason: 一手来源完整，属于大型发布会中的全新作品公布。
decisions.summary: 科乐美在 State of Play 公布动作游戏《Rhapsody in Scarlet》。作品以1920年代纽约为舞台，玩家操控年轻魔法师 Ellie，以近远程魔法、范围法术和召唤兽能力自由组合连段；PlayStation Blog 确认 PS5 版。
decisions.timeNote: PlayStation Blog 发表于北京时间9月3日22:33，处于固定窗口内。
decisions.verification: 已打开 PlayStation Blog 的开发者一手介绍，确认作品公布、舞台、主角、战斗机制与 PS5 平台；AUTOMATON 另行报道该消息。

decisions.headline: 《Final Fantasy Resonance》PS5体验版上线，可继承首章存档

decisions.summary: 《Final Fantasy Resonance》免费体验版已在 PS5 上线，包含完整第一章，存档可继承至10月22日发售的正式版。新预告还确认 Sephiroth 登场，游戏采用 HD-2D 风格与回合制战斗。
decisions.timeNote: PlayStation Blog 发表于北京时间9月3日21:24，处于固定窗口内。
decisions.verification: 已打开 PlayStation Blog 一手页面，确认体验版范围、存档继承、正式版日期、Sephiroth 登场及核心表现形式。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Final Fantasy VII Revelation Dated for April 8, 2027

entries.headline: Konami announces Rhapsody in Scarlet, built around magic-and-Beast combos
entries.summary: Konami unveiled Rhapsody in Scarlet, an action game set in 1920s New York. Players control the young mage Ellie, combining close- and long-range magic, area attacks, and Beast abilities; the PlayStation Blog confirms a PS5 version.
entries.timeNote: The PlayStation Blog post was published at 22:33 Beijing time on September 3, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened first-party PlayStation Blog post confirms the reveal, setting, protagonist, combat concept, and PS5 version.

entries.headline: Final Fantasy Resonance PS5 demo launches with full first chapter and save transfer
entries.summary: The free PS5 demo includes the complete first chapter and lets players carry progress into the full game, due October 22. The new trailer also confirms Sephiroth and highlights the HD-2D presentation and turn-based combat.
entries.timeNote: The PlayStation Blog post was published at 21:24 Beijing time on September 3, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog post confirms the demo scope, save transfer, full-game date, Sephiroth, and core presentation.

entries.headline: Gran Turismo 7's two-part Spec IV update will add 12 cars
entries.summary: The free Spec IV update arrives in two parts in October and December 2026, adding 12 cars, new circuits, and more competition options. The December release brings back Autumn Ring and adds Family Mode.
entries.timeNote: The PlayStation Blog post was published at 21:39 Beijing time on September 3, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog post confirms the two release months, 12 cars, Autumn Ring, and Family Mode.

entries.headline: Final Fantasy VII Revelation launches for PS5 on April 8, 2027
entries.summary: The finale of the remake trilogy is dated for April 8, 2027 on PS5. Newly shown features include instant party-member switching during exploration, grappling-hook traversal, and a new Queen's Blood storyline centered on Red XIII.
entries.timeNote: The PlayStation Blog post was published at 21:57 Beijing time on September 3, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog post and independent 4Gamer report agree on the title's role, PS5 platform, and April 8, 2027 release date.

entries.headline: BioEden launches with a restorative “4R” take on the 4X formula
entries.summary: BioEden is now available. Its developers recast the familiar expansion framework as Restore, Relax, Revive, and Recycle, asking players to balance construction and energy use against environmental damage.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire article was published at 00:00 Beijing time on September 4, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire developer feature confirms the launch, development team, 4R concept, and pollution mechanics.

entries.headline: Onimusha: Way of the Sword hands-on details a defense system built for counterattacks
entries.summary: Xbox Wire's pre-release hands-on explains how Parry builds the Blaze Gauge, Deflect damages stamina and can lead to Break Issen, and the riskier Issen counters just before an enemy lands a hit.
entries.timeNote: The article was published at 20:00 Beijing time on September 3, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire hands-on supports the mechanic descriptions; subjective impressions are not presented as official fact.

entries.headline: The Blood of Dawnwalker launches on Xbox Series and Xbox PC with Play Anywhere
entries.summary: Rebel Wolves' action RPG is now available on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox PC with Xbox Play Anywhere. Players control Coen, who is human by day and a vampire by night.
entries.timeNote: The article was published at 22:00 Beijing time on September 3, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire launch feature confirms the platforms, Play Anywhere support, protagonist, and day-night identity.

entries.headline: Echoes of Aincrad announces the Genesis Maidens DLC for this winter
entries.summary: The expansion adds a new side story across Aincrad's first two floors, new quest areas, a new weapon type, an armor-upgrade system, and Mito as an ally.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 23:17 Beijing time on September 3, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report details the release window and additions, but the packet does not include an opened primary page.

entries.headline: Crimson Desert's first major DLC launches October 15
entries.summary: Charting the Unknown follows Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane as they seek their own paths, adding unfamiliar regions and new enemies.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published its report at 21:42 Beijing time on September 3, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON and 4Gamer reports independently agree that this is the game's first major DLC and that it launches October 15.

entries.headline: Metro 2039 launches February 4, 2027
entries.summary: 4A Games confirmed the date during State of Play and showed a new trailer featuring ruined-city exploration and combat.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer page is dated September 3 and included in the fixed packet window; no exact time was available.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report confirms the developer, release date, and trailer; the packet does not provide an exact publication time.

entries.headline: Supercell's acquisition of Metacore is expected to close by the end of September
entries.summary: After closing, Merge Mansion will join Supercell's live-games portfolio, and both companies are already planning the transition.
entries.timeNote: The report is included in the fixed packet window, but the packet provides no exact publication time.
entries.verification: The opened Game Developer report confirms the expected closing period, the companies involved, and the product transfer.

entries.headline: Fate/EXTRA Record launches January 28, 2027
entries.summary: The full remake of Fate/EXTRA has been dated for January 28, 2027, with a new trailer showing several familiar Servants.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer page is dated September 3 and included in the fixed packet window; no exact time was available.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report confirms that Aniplex announced the date during State of Play; no opened primary page or exact publication time is in the packet.

entries.headline: Paper Mario soundtrack arrives on Nintendo Music with 148 tracks
entries.summary: The collection runs for four hours and 29 minutes and is available to Nintendo Switch Online members. It substantially expands on the out-of-print 78-track CD soundtrack.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 10:06 Beijing time on September 4, before the cutoff.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the release, service eligibility, track count, and duration; no opened Nintendo primary page is in the packet.

entries.headline: Bodycam update pushes Steam concurrency to around 30,000
entries.summary: Reissad Studio's major update adds features including a trench map and equipment customization. AUTOMATON reports that Steam concurrency rose to around 30,000 and set a new record for the game.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 15:50 Beijing time on September 3, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the update details and concurrency change; the figure is not presented as first-party platform data.

entries.headline: Battlestate Games launches a publishing division for hard-edged niche projects
entries.summary: The Escape from Tarkov developer has formed Battlestate Games Publishing. The new division is genre-agnostic and is seeking projects considered too hardcore, niche, or risky by conventional publishers.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 03:15 Beijing time on September 4, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report includes Battlestate Games' public statement, but the embedded statement is not a separate primary source in the packet.

checked: All English copy is bounded by the included decisions and their shared fact frames.
limited: Items lacking publishable subject identity remain under review and are not represented as Canonical stories.
sourceReport.note: Duplicate event packages and the State of Play recap were excluded to avoid repetition.
